title: Find the deep cut
brief: A fan shouted for 'Echoes'! Search forward through this DJ tracklist and delete that entire song entry so the crowd calms down.
text:
Track 1: Sunrise
Track 2: Echoes
Track 3: Midnight
Track 4: Dawn

expect.text:
Track 1: Sunrise
Track 3: Midnight
Track 4: Dawn

why: /pattern<CR> moves the cursor to the matching line, letting dd immediately remove it. No need to count lines manually.
author: claude (daily)
hint: Search lands your cursor on the match; then one command removes the whole line.
